title: Reverse a list with a loop
description: Write a function `reverse_list(items)` that returns `items` in reverse order, without using `list.reverse()`.
hints: Idea to consider: a slice with a negative step visits every item back-to-front
items[::-1] is a slice that starts at the end and steps backward by 1 through the whole list - it's the loop-free equivalent of iterating from the last index down to 0.
Return items[::-1] directly - it already builds a new, reversed list.
expected_behavior: Returns a new list with items in reverse order.
explanation: A slice's step argument can be negative, which walks the sequence backward - items[::-1] is equivalent to a loop that appends items from the last index down to the first.
